subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should gateway-drain bypass capability be exposed through the public ChannelRunQueue plugin SDK type, or kept as a core-private restart helper?
rationale: The PR currently publishes an internal restart-drain bypass to third-party plugin code; that is a trust-boundary and SDK-contract choice, not just an implementation detail.

options.title: Keep bypass private
options.body: Remove or privatize the public enqueueInternal surface and keep restart-drain admission under core-owned helpers while preserving bundled channel behavior.

options.title: Approve SDK contract
options.body: Accept the public bypass only with explicit docs, API baseline/contract tests, and a named trust model for third-party plugins.

options.title: Pause behind restart-loss work
options.body: Defer this branch if maintainers prefer the broader persisted queue and catch-up design to own restart message loss instead.

recommendation.title: Keep bypass private
recommendation.body: Remove or privatize the public enqueueInternal surface and keep restart-drain admission under core-owned helpers while preserving bundled channel behavior.
